<thought>All leaf reagents must be commercially available. I verified that the following simple building blocks are buyable: 4‑fluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride, N‑Boc‑piperazine, and tetralin‑1‑ol. Using these, a concise 5‑step retrosynthetic route can be constructed that reaches the target molecule without exceeding the 6‑step limit. The route is expressed as a hierarchical JSON tree with reaction nodes (template IDs are placeholders) and leaf nodes that are buyable chemicals.</thought>
